document.title: The shape of attentive reading in an age of agents
document.text:
Reading should feel calm even when the ideas are difficult. The interface should preserve context without asking the reader to pay a permanent tax in vertical space.

A durable session is more than a page title. It is the reader's place in an ongoing body of work: the source, saved interpretations, notes, and the path back to them.

Global identity, session context, and local analytical tools all matter. They should remain available without competing as three equally weighted headers.

The strongest interface keeps the active text primary, the session easy to recover, and local tools close to the material they affect.

When the reader moves into Close Reading, the analysis becomes a second surface rather than a second application. The source and interpretation should share one stable frame.

Consistent scrolling is part of that frame. Switching modes should not silently change which header can move, which pane owns the wheel, or how much of the viewport remains for the text.

A compact application bar can preserve identity and critical status. A session title can sit beside it, while mode navigation communicates the current working view.

Local analysis controls belong to the analysis pane. Their visual weight should be lower than the session itself, because they operate on the current artifact rather than defining the workspace.

This hierarchy makes long reading sessions quieter. The interface remains legible, recoverable, and ready for the next action without continually announcing its own structure.

The result is not minimalism for its own sake. It is an allocation of attention: durable context stays available, temporary controls stay local, and the text receives the largest uninterrupted field.

artifacts.title: Close Reading
artifacts.content:
## Central movement

The text argues that interface hierarchy is part of the reading experience. Global identity, session context, and local analytical tools should remain available, but they should not compete as three equally weighted headers.

## Design consequence

Keep the durable session visible and let local analysis tools occupy a quieter, subordinate layer.
